questions.question: Which TWO resources are required for an Azure virtual machine?

options.text: A managed disk for the OS

questions.explanation: VMs need a disk, NIC and virtual network; public IP and NSG are optional.

questions.question: How do you stop paying for compute on an Azure VM you are not using?

options.text: Shut down the OS from inside the VM
options.why: The VM stays allocated and billed.

questions.explanation: Deallocation releases hardware and stops compute charges.

questions.question: A company must migrate a Windows app with a vendor agent quickly with no code changes. Which service?

options.why: May not support the vendor agent.

questions.explanation: VMs suit lift-and-shift and custom software.
